info.title: incursion-kit waitlist API
info.description:
The HTTP API of the incursion-kit waitlist server. It is wire-compatible with the legacy
community waitlist, so existing frontends keep working.

- **Authentication**: the `authToken` session cookie, set by `POST /api/auth/cb` after an EVE SSO
  login (`GET /api/auth/login_url`). Operations that need a login list the `session` scheme;
  its scopes are the permission keys the operation requires.
- **Errors** are plain text (`text/plain`), not JSON: `401 Authorization Required` without a
  session, `access denied` without a permission, `404 Not Found` for unknown paths, unsupported
  methods and malformed parameters.
- **Request bodies** are JSON; the `Content-Type` header is optional.
- **Live events** are server-sent events: `GET /api/sse/stream` (logged in) and
  `GET /api/incursions/stream` (public).

The guide to the API (sessions, roles and permission keys, live event topics) is `docs/api.md`
in the repository.

post.description:
Replaces an editable file with the request body (raw text, any content type):

- `<page>.<locale>.json`: must be a non-empty JSON object of strings; backed up, then
  written. Guide pages (and any page with `kind=guide`) go to the guide's directory.
- `languages.json`: a JSON object of code → label strings.
- A community data file: the whole data set is validated with the new file **before**
  anything is written (the legacy waitlist wrote first), then the old file is backed up, the
  new one written atomically and the new data loaded. Warnings (e.g. skill plans that no
  longer build) are logged, not returned.

Requires `commanders-manage:admin`.

`srp_setup` login (requires `commanders-manage:admin`) stores the character as the SRP service
account and keeps the admin's session: frontends that compare the state exactly with
`"srp_setup"` send it here instead of to the `GET` variant.

time_spent_in_fleet_by_month.description:
Month → fleet-time bucket (`a. <1h`, `b. 1-5h`, `c. 5-15h`, `d. 15-40h`, `e. 40h+`) →
pilots whose total fleet time that month falls in it. Empty buckets are omitted.

x_vs_time_by_hull_28d.description:
Hull → `{"X": share of x-ups, "Time": share of fleet time}` over the last 28 days. Hulls
that are under 1% of x-ups count towards `"Other"` in both. A share is `null` when its
total is zero (0/0, as the legacy waitlist sent it).

xes_by_hull_28d.description: Hull → distinct pilots that x'd up with it in the last 28 days.

xes_by_hull_by_month.description: Month → hull → distinct pilots that x'd up with it.

fc_srp_price_factor.description: The configured `srp_updater.fc_srp_price_factor`: FCs may pay the tier prices times this.

payment_amount.description: ISK paid for the covering payment.

status.description: `Unpaid`, `Paid until end of focus` or `Paid until YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC`.

loot_returned.description: Whether the loot was returned to the victim.

longest_warp_au.description: Longest distance between two of them: roughly the longest warp.

radius_au.description: Sun to the farthest planet, stargate or station.

role_source.description: `known` (ESI or a published layout), `estimated` (stargate graph) or `unknown`.

TierTable.description: The tier table as clients see it (prices in millions of ISK; entry n covers n characters).

show_on_waitlist.description: `true` pins the note (unpinning the character's other notes), `false` unpins it.

key.description:
Any key; `show_fc_killmail_links` (`true`/`1` to show links to FCs) is the one the
server reads.

character_id.description: One of the caller's own characters, in the fleet.

character_name.description: The pilot to assign, as named in game.

role.description:
MOTD role name (case-insensitive; one of `fleet.motd_roles` in `rules.yaml`, though an
unknown role is accepted and written in upper case).

has_incorrect_hull.description: The pilot is in fleet in a ship that isn't one of the role's hulls.

is_duplicate.description: The pilot was already listed under the role.

loot_returned.description: Whether the loot was returned to the victim.

filename.description: The name the image was saved under (an opaque PNG that was optimized becomes `.jpg`).

oneOf.description:
The account's main (`corporation_id` is always `null`). Own entry or `waitlist-view`
only.

waitlist_note.description: The pinned pilot note on the account's main. `waitlist-view` only.

oneOf.description:
The pilot flying the fit (`corporation_id` is always `null`). Own entry or
`waitlist-view` only.

dna.description: The fit as DNA. Own entry or `waitlist-view` + `fit-view` only.

oneOf.description:
How the fit differs from the doctrine fit it matched (`null` when none was compared).
Own entry or `waitlist-view` + `fit-view` only.

hours_in_fleet.description: Whole hours in fleet when x'd up. Own entry or `waitlist-view` only.

id.description: Fit x-up ID (for approve, reject, invite and remove_fit).

implants.description: The pilot's implant type IDs. Own entry or `waitlist-view` + `fit-view` only.

messagexup.description: The pilot's x-up message. Own entry or `waitlist-view` only.

tags.description: All tags for the own entry or with `waitlist-view`; otherwise only the public tags.

categories.description: Names of the waitlist categories, in configured order.

open.description: Whether the waitlist is open (`false` for an unknown waitlist).

waitlist.description: The entries in join order; `null` when the waitlist is closed or doesn't exist.

WalletJournalEntry.description:
A wallet journal entry as the admin journal endpoint returns it (ESI's shape, with the
`*_party_type` fields the legacy waitlist declared; ESI no longer sends them, so they are
always `null`).

after_spawn_id.description: The ended spawn whose slot this window refills.

dna.description: The fit in EVE ship DNA format.

implants.description: Implant type ids the character had at the time.

logged_at.description: When the character x'd up (Unix seconds).

character_id.description: One of the caller's own characters: the pilot of the EFT fits.

dna.description: More fits, each with its own pilot.

eft.description: One or more fits in EFT format (may be empty when `dna` has fits).

is_alt.description: X-up as an alt (invited into the `alt` category's squad).

messagexup.description: A message for the FCs, at most 100 bytes (may be empty).

warnings.description: Notes for the pilot, e.g. that some categories are blocked while at war.

session.name: authToken
session.description: The session cookie set by `POST /api/auth/cb`. Scopes listed on an operation are the permission keys it requires (see the roles table in `docs/api.md`).
